As per coding guidelines, “Use multiple fleets in your automated tests and manual QA.”

Full details: Title check

**Explanation** The title names the main change: the fleet name is now included in the role activity logged when a user is created with fleet roles. It matches the changeset (CreateUser fills fleet names before creation) and the linked issue. It uses the fix prefix and stays within one sentence.
Full details: Description check

**Explanation** The description follows the repository template in its main parts. It links the issue (Resolves `#59514`), explains the root cause and fix, and lists the new test. It checks the changes file item and the automated test item, and it includes the required AI section. Two items are missing: the manual QA box is unchecked, and the template's frontend, database, Apple MDM, GitOps, and fleetd sections are absent. The description does not mention the screenshot requirement, but no user-visible UI change applies. The core content is complete, so the check passes.
Full details: Linked Issues check

**Explanation** [`#59514`] requires that creating a user with fleet roles logs changed_user_fleet_role with the fleet's name in fleet_name. The whole-PR diff of server/service/users.go shows the root cause fix: CreateUser now builds teamNames from TeamsSummary (ID to Name), copies each fleet.UserTeam into namedTeams with Team.Name filled from that map, and sets p.Teams to &namedTeams before the user is created. Because UserTeam embeds Team by value, the Name assignment changes only the copied value. The existing unknown-ID invalid-argument error is kept. server/service/users_test.go adds TestCreateUserTeamRoleActivityHasTeamName, which creates a user with fleet 7 as observer and asserts the activity's TeamID is 7 and TeamName is "Workstations". The only coding requirement is this fleet-name fix, and the code implements it. No parent or contextual issues apply. Manual QA is non-coding and does not affect this verdict. The test was not executed in this review; the verdict rests on the source diff.
Full details: Out of Scope Changes check

**Explanation** The PR changes three paths. changes/59514-... adds the changelog entry for the user-visible fix. server/service/users.go contains only the name-lookup and copy logic that the objective requires. server/service/users_test.go adds one test for this behavior and the activity_api import that the test uses. No unrelated hunks appear in the reviewed diffs. The copy-before-mutate design is part of the fix, not a separate change.
